title: Rocky Learns to Listen
moral: Listening to others helps keep you safe.

scenes.summary: Rocky is a playful dog who loves exploring but does not like listening.
scenes.text:
Rocky the Dog Who Didn’t Listen

In a small, happy village, lived a playful dog named Rocky.

Rocky loved to run, jump, and explore everywhere.

But there was one problem…

Rocky didn’t like listening.
scenes.image_prompt: playful dog running happily in a village, bright colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Rocky ignores his owner’s instructions and keeps running off.
scenes.text:
“Rocky, come back!” his owner called.

But Rocky kept running.

“Rocky, don’t go there!” she warned.

But Rocky didn’t stop.

“I know what I’m doing!” Rocky barked.
scenes.image_prompt: dog running away ignoring owner calling, cheerful village cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Rocky runs far away chasing a butterfly and gets lost.
scenes.text:
One day, Rocky chased a butterfly far away from home.

Over hills…

Past trees…

Across a small stream…

Finally, he stopped.

“Where am I?” Rocky looked around.

Everything seemed strange.
scenes.image_prompt: dog chasing butterfly across hills and trees into unknown place, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Rocky realizes he is lost and meets Pip who offers to help him.
scenes.text:
Rocky tried to find his way back.

But he couldn’t.

“I should have listened,” he said.

He felt scared and alone.

Just then, a little bird named Pip flew down.

“Are you lost?” Pip asked.

“Yes,” Rocky said sadly.

“I didn’t listen… and now I can’t find my home.”

Pip smiled.

“I’ll help you,” he said.
scenes.image_prompt: lost dog looking sad while small bird talks kindly, forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: Rocky returns home safely and learns the importance of listening.
scenes.text:
Pip flew ahead, showing Rocky the path.

“Follow me,” he chirped.

Rocky followed carefully.

Step by step, they made their way back.

Soon, Rocky saw his home!

Rocky ran to his owner.

“I’m sorry,” he said.

“I should have listened.”

His owner hugged him.

“I’m glad you’re safe,” she said.

Listening to others keeps you safe.

Good advice is there to help you.

The End

story:
Rocky the Dog Who Didn’t Listen

In a small, happy village, lived a playful dog named Rocky.

Rocky loved to run, jump, and explore everywhere.

But there was one problem…

Rocky didn’t like listening.

“Rocky, come back!” his owner called.

But Rocky kept running.

“Rocky, don’t go there!” she warned.

But Rocky didn’t stop.

“I know what I’m doing!” Rocky barked.

One day, Rocky chased a butterfly far away from home.

Over hills…

Past trees…

Across a small stream…

Finally, he stopped.

“Where am I?” Rocky looked around.

Everything seemed strange.

Rocky tried to find his way back.

But he couldn’t.

“I should have listened,” he said.

He felt scared and alone.

Just then, a little bird named Pip flew down.

“Are you lost?” Pip asked.

“Yes,” Rocky said sadly.

“I didn’t listen… and now I can’t find my home.”

Pip smiled.

“I’ll help you,” he said.

Pip flew ahead, showing Rocky the path.

“Follow me,” he chirped.

Rocky followed carefully.

Step by step, they made their way back.

Soon, Rocky saw his home!

Rocky ran to his owner.

“I’m sorry,” he said.

“I should have listened.”

His owner hugged him.

“I’m glad you’re safe,” she said.

Listening to others keeps you safe.

Good advice is there to help you.

The End
